Attached is a draft invitation for Globex (Invitation_Letter_Globex_draft.docx). Key notes:

- I used the event dates (Nov 15-17) and listed the primary attendees by role. Please confirm full legal name to use for the company line (Redwood Inference, Inc. vs Redwood Inference LLC).
- Recommended consulate booking guidance (summary):
  * Aim to book biometrics/visa appointment 4–8 weeks before travel for EU/UK — 8 weeks if applying from high-demand cities.
  * For tight timelines (<3 weeks), recommend express appointment through a visa concierge. We’ve worked with Visa Concierge (visa-concierge@visasrus.com) before.
  * For passport validity: for UK specifically the passport must be valid for the period of stay; however, many carrier/re-entry rules are stricter — advise travelers to have at least 3–6 months beyond departure when possible.

I’ll circulate a one-page traveler checklist and a short consulate booking step-by-step (I’ll attach consulate-booking-guide.pdf).
